name: OpenClaw Exporter to Langfuse
description: Export OpenClaw AI agent execution traces to Langfuse via OpenTelemetry

headers.description: HTTP headers for OTLP authentication (Langfuse: Authorization)

tags.description: Custom Langfuse tags applied to the trace root span (e.g. ["id:openclaw", "ip:127.0.0.1"]).

userId.description: User ID for traces. Defaults to the OS username; when configured, overrides the OS default. Priority: config > OS account > "unknown".

batchSize.description: Number of spans to buffer before sending

flushIntervalMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait before sending buffered spans

enabledHooks.description: Deprecated: tracing requires all lifecycle hooks. Omit this setting.

skillsRoots.description: Explicit skill roots for skill tag detection. Highest priority; when set, auto-detection is skipped.

skillTaggingEnabled.description: Enable skill tag detection and emit skill:* tags to Langfuse tool observations.

evaluationEnabled.description: Enable authenticated langfuse.agent.prepare/result Gateway RPC methods for experiment context propagation.

evaluationResultTtlMs.description: Retain terminal evaluation results from completion, in milliseconds. Default 24 hours.

evaluationPreparedTimeoutMs.description: Admission wait before unknown status, in milliseconds. Zero disables the wait limit; late admission can still bind retained requests.

evaluationMaxEntries.description: Maximum retained evaluation records. Reject new admissions at capacity; do not evict live or unexpired results.
